titulo: A monkey born from a stone 🐒 Sun Wukong Part 1 #story #shorts
descripcion:
A stone on the edge of the world cracks open, and a monkey steps out with gold burning in his eyes. Heaven laughs. That was its first mistake.

> Part 2: tomorrow. Follow so you don't miss it.
Would you have jumped through the waterfall?

From Journey to the West (Xiyouji), Wu Cheng'en, 16th century, chapter 1.
